<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the documentation of org.hortonmachine.modules.LineSmootherJaitools: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

The smoothed line passes through all the vertices of the original one: each segment is replaced by a cubic Bezier curve of 10 vertices, with the control points set by the neighbouring segments, so the line gets 9 new vertices for each segment. With an alpha of 1 the curves are the straight segments, so the line keeps its shape, only with more vertices; with 0 they are the roundest. Since the curve doesn't cut the corners, on the staircase lines of a vectorized raster it rounds the steps instead of removing them: simplify the lines first, with VectorSimplifier, to smooth their general shape.

Only the lines of the features are smoothed, as multi lines: features without lines are left out.
